title: Relay protocol and remote threat contract
objective: Freeze the P15 relay protocol and remote threat contract before any network code merges: routing, request and response frames, authenticated identity binding, selected-device binding, request digest binding, replay behavior, sequencing, duplication, reconnect behavior, queue behavior, cancellation, expiry, quotas, privacy, logging, offline semantics, and typed failures. The relay carries only Cotra-defined authenticated MCP traffic and is never a generic proxy.

include: relay routing and Cotra-defined authenticated request and response frames
authenticated identity binding, selected-device binding, and request digest binding
replay, sequencing, duplication, reconnect, queue, cancellation, and expiry behavior
quotas, privacy, logging, offline semantics, and typed failures
remote threat contract: relay compromise must not mint local authority
contract tests proving the frozen vocabulary before implementation grains proceed
exclude: any relay, device uplink, OAuth, or public edge implementation code
arbitrary TCP forwarding, SOCKS, CONNECT, generic HTTP proxy, arbitrary WebSocket tunnel, arbitrary destination forwarding, or remote shell transport
any new local MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, or approval change
any P16 tool-surface widening or provider submission
any public provider submission, directory publication, or availability claim

invariants: no network code merges until this contract is frozen
the relay may carry only Cotra-defined authenticated MCP traffic
relay compromise cannot create local authority
cotrad remains the local authorization kernel and the relay remains an adapter
no durable request queue may execute after lease expiration, revoke, lock, logoff, or policy change

acceptance.claim: Routing, request and response frames, identity and device and digest bindings, and the typed failure vocabulary including REMOTE_SESSION_INACTIVE are frozen in canonical documents.

Replay, sequencing, duplication, reconnect, queue, cancellation, expiry, quota, privacy, logging, and offline behavior are specified with fail-closed semantics, and generic proxy shapes are explicitly denied.
Contract tests prove the frozen vocabulary, and all closed SG-000001 through SG-000051 regressions pass unchanged.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000053: Device identity, pairing, and revocation may proceed only after SG-000052 closes with the relay protocol and remote threat contract frozen.

done_when: The relay protocol and remote threat contract is frozen with denied generic-proxy shapes and no network implementation.
